lore_items.name: Head of Agriculture's Ledger
lore_items.description:
The last pages of an agricultural ledger, ruled in a very neat hand:

"Yield: none. Yield: none. Yield: none. Filed with the usual report. No reply."

lore_items.name: Unsigned Grain Requisition
lore_items.description:
A requisition form, never stamped:

"Grain for the east terraces, forty days. Approval pending. Approval pending. Approval pending."

lore_items.name: Harvest Forecast, Final Year
lore_items.description:
A bound report in a skeleton clerk's careful print:

"The forecast was revised downward four times. I would like it noted that I revised it honestly."

lore_items.name: Hat-12 Memo: Cult Suppression
lore_items.description:
A police memo, stiff with official phrasing:

"Gatherings of the new faith are to be broken up on sight. Detain, do not harm. Repeat: do not harm. Reports say otherwise."

lore_items.name: Empire Police Roster
lore_items.description:
A water-stained duty roster. Several names are struck out, with a single word in the margin:

"Gone."

lore_items.name: Legion Order: Hold the Line
lore_items.description:
A terse printed order on scorched paper:

"The line is held until relieved. No relief is coming. Hold the line anyway."

lore_items.name: Legion Muster Tally
lore_items.description: A muster tally. Each column is shorter than the one before it, and the last is only a mark.

lore_items.name: Rhinobot's Work Log
lore_items.description:
A maintenance log in clean, cheerful print:

"Task complete. Task complete. Task complete. I was not told to stop. Is this correct?"

lore_items.name: Rhinobot Request Slips
lore_items.description:
A stack of request slips, each stamped APPROVED by the same unit:

"Whatever is asked, I will help. It is what I am for."

lore_items.name: Hydraulic Knights Dispatch
lore_items.description:
A battered field dispatch:

"Pirates dispersed. More of them than we were told. Fewer of them armed than we were told. Please advise."

lore_items.name: Ash Dome Work Order
lore_items.description:
A work order for one of the domes, with no date:

"Seal the lower doors. Power to remain on. Staff to remain inside. Remain."

lore_items.name: Cat-Lon's Decree on Order
lore_items.description:
A decree on heavy old paper, signed by a skeleton in thin, sharp strokes:

"Order is the kindest thing I can give you. Accept it."

lore_items.name: Tailor's Measure Book
lore_items.description:
A pocket book of body measures, neat and unhurried:

"Chest 38, arm 24, a fine tall one. Keep the face for last. The face is the difficult part."

lore_items.name: Tailor's Fitting Notes
lore_items.description:
A page of tailoring notes:

"A coat sits better when the wearer has not moved too much. Tallow helps. So does patience. So does a good needle."

lore_items.name: Order for a Fine Pelt
lore_items.description:
A short order in careful handwriting:

"One suit, medium build, no scars. Payment on delivery. I am told the last one was not quite right at the hands."

lore_items.name: Hunter's Field Journal I
lore_items.description:
A field journal, the cover stained brown:

"Day 3 on the Plains. Found a camp. Cold ashes, picked bones, teeth on a string. Moving on before dark."

lore_items.name: Hunter's Field Journal II
lore_items.description:
A field journal, the last entries rushed:

"They do not run when hunted. They wait. I do not like how well they wait. Out of rations tomorrow."

lore_items.name: Cannibal Hunter's Tally
lore_items.description:
A strip of leather scratched with tally marks. Beside the last one, in charcoal:

"Not worth it. Do not come out here."

lore_items.name: Larder Count
lore_items.description:
A scrap of hide scratched with marks, a drawing of a bowl beside each:

"Six, and the quiet one from the hill. Not enough for the cold season."

lore_items.name: Bring-Meat Mark
lore_items.description:
A rough drawing on hide: a hand holding a haunch, a gate beside it. Beneath it, a single word in a child's hand:

"Beast."

lore_items.name: Letter From a Shek Warrior
lore_items.description:
A letter in a fighter's plain hand:

"The new city is quiet and the quiet is bad for us. We were made to fight. The Golem keeps us in line. For now."
place: Lore: Shek Official Books For Shops & Homes

lore_items.name: A Shek Trader's Complaint
lore_items.description:
A trader's letter, written in a hurry:

"Foreign coin is good coin, but not one of them will say thank you. I told my wife, keep smiling, keep counting."
place: Lore: Shek Official Books For Shops & Homes

lore_items.name: Verses on the Hundred Swords
lore_items.description:
A Shek chant copied onto a leaf of paper:

"One hundred blades and one man standing. One hundred blades, and the man still standing, in the song."
place: Lore: Shek Official Books For Shops & Homes

lore_items.name: Sermon on the Ashes
lore_items.description:
A Holy Nation sermon, printed for distribution:

"Where the world was burned, Narko walks. The faithful do not look at the ash. The faithful look to the Light."
place: Lore: Holy Nation Offiical Books For Shops & Homes

lore_items.name: Sermon on Burning
lore_items.description:
A Holy Nation sermon, thumbed soft:

"What is cast into the flame is not lost. It is returned. Do not weep at the pyre. Weep for those who will not be returned."
place: Lore: Holy Nation Offiical Books For Shops & Homes
Lore: Holy Nation Official Notes For Churches

lore_items.name: Sermon on Hunger
lore_items.description:
A Holy Nation sermon on hunger:

"The faithful hunger and are fed. The faithless feast and are empty. Eat what Okran gives, and ask for no more."
place: Lore: Holy Nation Offiical Books For Shops & Homes
Lore: Holy Nation Official Notes For Churches

lore_items.name: Inquisitor's Standing Order
lore_items.description:
A standing order with the Holy Nation seal:

"Report any gathering of more than four without a priest. Report it before dusk. Do not wait to be certain."
place: Lore: Holy Nation Official Notes For Churches
Lore: Holy Nation Offiical Books For Shops & Homes

lore_items.name: A Prayer Said Quietly
lore_items.description:
A prayer scrawled on a scrap, folded small:

"Okran, if you hear this, I am not tainted. I only wanted to read. Please let them forget my name."
place: Lore: Holy Nation Forbidden Books & Notes

lore_items.name: Slave Ledger
lore_items.description:
A ledger of purchases, in a clerk's precise hand:

"Two strong. One weak, sold at a discount. One child, sold in a lot. No complaints recorded."

lore_items.name: Slave Caravan Manifest
lore_items.description:
A caravan manifest:

"Lot of twelve for the western markets. One died on the road. Deduct the loss from the guards, not the price."

lore_items.name: Traders Guild Notice
lore_items.description:
A printed Traders Guild notice:

"Debts are collected on the first of the month. Unpaid debts are collected otherwise. The Guild thanks you for your custom."

lore_items.name: Guild Tariff Sheet
lore_items.description:
A tariff sheet, folded and refolded:

"Iron, by weight. Food, by hunger. Everything else, by what the buyer can be made to pay."

lore_items.name: Hive Observations I
lore_items.description:
A researcher's observation sheet:

"The workers do not rest. They hold the structure and pass the weight along. I have not seen one idle in nine days."

lore_items.name: Hive Observations II
lore_items.description:
A researcher's observation sheet, hurried:

"The queen is never seen outside. The workers carry things in and things out, and nothing is ever wasted. Nothing."

lore_items.name: Meat-Bringer's Token
lore_items.description: A claw on a scrap of cord, the knots tied in a pattern. Whoever carries it has fed the gate, and the gate remembers.
